title: Morty Defeats Scorpions to Pass Bechdel Test

cuts.voiceover_text: Trapped inside the story train, Rick desperately demands a narrative that passes the Bechdel test. Two named women must talk about anything other than a man.

Morty panics and crafts an absurdly awkward tale starring his mother Beth and sister Summer. Drinking warm tea, Summer nervously asks about her special time. Beth reassures her that her heavy cycle is a source of pure strength, validating their bond.

Suddenly, giant female scorpions ambush their home. Beth and Summer channel their heavy special time into devastating rainbow laser beams, completely incinerating the beasts. Their ridiculous narrative triumph breaks the train's thematic seal, leaving Rick and Morty celebrating.
